title: Weather in Our City
text:
Today the weather is very cold. The sky is grey and it is raining a little. There is a strong wind outside. People wear warm coats and hats.

Tomorrow it will be sunny and warm. The sun will shine all day. Children can play in the park. We will have a picnic in the afternoon.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What will we have in the afternoon tomorrow?
Why do people wear warm coats and hats today?
options: Because the weather is cold and windy
Because they are going to swim

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about tomorrow?

vocabulary.definition: with a lot of bright sunshine
air that moves quickly across the land
a meal eaten outdoors, often in a park
when water falls from the sky as drops

paragraph_translations: Bugün hava çok soğuk. Gökyüzü gri ve biraz yağmur yağıyor. Dışarıda güçlü bir rüzgar var. İnsanlar sıcak paltolar ve şapkalar giyiyor.
Yarın hava güneşli ve sıcak olacak. Güneş bütün gün parlayacak. Çocuklar parkta oynayabilir. Öğleden sonra piknik yapacağız.
